summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry ("\x1b]0;{title}\x07") and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when the control is written and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests were added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only. The Console test skips its assertion on legacy Windows, and the renderer test relies on the module's existing win32-only skip.
